proven_params.result: Human 40 ATAC UMAP computed from LSI embeddings (30K subsample of 265909 cells). DoubletScore range: 0-192, DoubletEnrichment 0-9.1. UMAP successful.

proven_params.script: 官网站点查阅: 12.2 Calling Peaks w/ Macs2
proven_params.params: 流程: addGroupCoverages → addReproduciblePeakSet(pathToMacs2, peaksPerCell, reproducibility) → getPeakSet → addPeakMatrix
proven_params.result: 官网12.2确认官方peak calling流程：必须先addGroupCoverages生成pseudo-bulk覆盖，再addReproduciblePeakSet用MACS2（pathToMacs2可指定）做reproducible peak calling，两阶段（先per-group reproducible peaks，再union合并），默认reproducibility=2指至少2

实测 ArchR 官方默认参数：addGroupCoverages minCells=40/maxCells=500/maxFragments=25e6(不是8e7)/minReplicates=2/maxReplicates=5/sampleRatio=0.8；addReproduciblePeakSet peakMethod=Macs2/reproducibility="2"/peaksPer

when_to_use: ArchR scATAC-seq 全流程:环境搭建 → Arrow 加载 → QC → LSI → 聚类 → Peak Calling → 差异可及性 → TF footprinting → motif 富集。支持跨物种 CRE 保守性评估。 Signac 作为备选方案…
